informal_statement: Issue #286: in PR #289's two-channel gluon vertex relation, the non-Abelian gate (non-collinear pairs only) does work on singlet distance d_G, but only by lengthening it: against the same channels ungated, 24 states go from d_G = 1 to 2 and 32 are blocked, and no state is shorter gated. #289's 'every first-singlet move reduces d_G' holds for every move relation and is bookkeeping.

approximation_or_regime.name: Two-channel F3^2 vertex toy
approximation_or_regime.description: Multisets of 1-4 nonzero F3^2 labels; create adds -(q+r), glue replaces q, r by -(q+r); singlet = total colour 0; search size <= 5.
approximation_or_regime.validity_limits: PR #289's finite toy. No quarks, kinematics, coupling, physical distance (GL7) or string tension (GL8).

formal_statement.statement_scope: The bookkeeping lemma is general; the closing conditions hold on all of F3^2; the witnesses are explicit. The 24 / 32 state counts are numerical.

formal_object.type: control comparison of two move relations

dependencies.audit_baseline: New anchors added to QLF_AxiomAudit and the exact-footprint baseline (543 entries).
dependencies.qlf_bridge_axioms: None. Footprints are propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound, or none.

inputs.name: gated relation
inputs.value: PR #289 create + glue with symp(q, r) != 0

inputs.name: Abelian control
inputs.value: same channels, any pair with q + r != 0

interpretation.map: colour state -> d_G under each relation
interpretation.formal_status: Closing conditions and witnesses formal; state counts numerical.
interpretation.noncircularity_test: A1-A5 and the verdict rule were committed before gluon_abelian_control.py existed; A3 and A5 could have failed.

strange_loop.name: colour state -> vertex moves -> singlet closure
strange_loop.conservative_return: Both relations return singlet closure on every state with a path; the gated one never shorter.
strange_loop.noncircularity_witness: Neither relation consults d_G; the control differs only in the non-Abelian gate.
strange_loop.first_order_note: F: QLF_GluonAbelianControl anchors. N: gluon_abelian_control.py, exhaustive.
strange_loop.defeater: A distance-reducing role for the gluon that comes from its non-Abelian structure in another move relation.

proof_obligation.falsifier: a state with shorter gated than ungated d_G (impossible: the gated relation is a subrelation)

measurement_protocol.design: No empirical measurement. Pre-registered A1-A5 in Gluon_Abelian_Control.md section 1.
measurement_protocol.failure_condition: Verdict rule: A3 and A5 failing would make d_G Abelian.

reported_agreement.value: non-Abelian gate lengthens d_G only; first-singlet reduction is bookkeeping

evidence.N: gluon_abelian_control.py: gated reproduces #289; 24 lengthened, 32 blocked; ungated classes create 256/32/128, glue 592/272/544.

defeaters.formal: A counterexample to the QLF_GluonAbelianControl anchors.
defeaters.interpretation: One toy relation; other channels (quark emission, multi-step binding) are untested.
defeaters.conceptual: Logical distance is not physical distance (GL7 open).
